minimal_closing_object.acceptance: exact phase or certified controlled approximation, with no oscillation datum used to choose operator, loop, spin structure or branch
minimal_closing_object.calculation: compute determinant-line holonomy around a source-selected loop and prove arg hol=3*phi_nu modulo 2*pi
minimal_closing_object.normalization: derive reduced-eta, orientation and local-term subtraction from the same action
minimal_closing_object.operator: D_nu(phi) on S1_cen x L(3,1) x (Gamma\Nil3), twisted by the selected q79/F,m=1 bundle and Hcen family action

primary_framework.scope: Exponentiated eta invariants define determinant-line data and its holonomy only for a specified family of Dirac-type operators with the required geometric structures.
